transcription.notes: Thirteen printed blocks A–M (the catalogue title list stops at L but counts 13). Each block is one problem; its roman-numbered questions are parts. Each question ends with the points in brackets, e.g. [3], followed by a dash and the answer code (e.g. “- 234” for 23.4°); the points go into part.points and the code into part.answer.value, and the problem points are the sum of its parts (no totals are printed). Blanks printed as underscores (M_, NGC_, 3C_) are kept as escaped underscores. Kept as printed: “Betelguese”, “Duschbba”, “Dumbell Nebula”, “Chandrayan-1”, “Brache”, “Cancer Nebula” (for the Crab Nebula) in M.ii, “is consisted of”, “A.U. And”, “o’ clock”, the stray period in “E_{B-V}.,” in E.i, and “Chandrasekhar Mass limit in solar radii” in E.iv (the answer 1.44 is in solar masses). The atmosphere table in M.iii is printed as an image and is transcribed as a Markdown table; wavy underlines in it are the word processor’s spell-check marks, not printed emphasis. The list bullets in M.ii are printed as “÷” glyphs and are rendered as a Markdown list. Figure G (M81/M82) serves both G.i and G.ii and is attached to G.i. I.ix is highlighted in yellow in the source.
